responsibility: Implements the runtime representation of resolved Rust traits and their associated items used by the typechecker. The file provides TraitItemReference and TraitReference operations for naming, lookup across direct and super traits, lazily computing associated item TyTy types, tracking optional versus required items, clearing or updating associated-type state, checking trait equality and object safety, and storing the impl/trait/self tuple for an associated trait implementation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the behavior of resolved trait wrapper objects, including trait-item lookup across supertraits, lazy TyTy computation for items, associated-type state management, equality, and object-safety checks. Unlike rust-hir-trait-reference.h, this file provides the runtime operations of TraitReference/TraitItemReference rather than just declaring those wrapper types.
